gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.description: Read, search, draft and send email

actions.title: Send Email
actions.description: Sends an email via Gmail API using the authenticated user's Google profile display name.

actions.title: Delete Draft
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific Gmail draft using its ID with no recovery possible; verify the correct `draft_id` and obtain explicit user confirmation before calling.

actions.title: Delete message
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specific email message by its ID from a Gmail mailbox; for `user_id`, use 'me' for the authenticated user or an email address to which the authenticated user has delegated access.

actions.title: Fetch emails
actions.description: Fetches a list of email messages from a Gmail account, supporting filtering, pagination, and optional full content retrieval.

actions.title: Fetch message by message ID
actions.description: Fetches a specific email message by its ID, provided the `message_id` exists and is accessible to the authenticated `user_id`.

actions.title: Get Gmail attachment
actions.description: Retrieves a specific attachment by ID from a message in a user's Gmail mailbox, requiring valid message and attachment IDs.

actions.title: Move to Trash
actions.description: Moves an existing, non-deleted email message to the trash for the specified user.

actions.title: Reply to email thread
actions.description: Sends a reply within a specific Gmail thread using the original thread's subject; do not provide a custom subject as it will start a new conversation instead of replying in-thread.

actions.title: Search People
actions.description: Searches contacts by matching the query against names, nicknames, emails, phone numbers, and organizations, optionally including 'Other Contacts'.

actions.title: Send Draft
actions.description: Sends an existing draft email AS-IS to recipients already defined within the draft.

actions.title: Create email draft
actions.description: Creates a Gmail email draft.

actions.title: Patch Event
actions.description: Update specified fields of an existing event in a Google Calendar using patch semantics (array fields like `attendees` are fully replaced if provided); ensure the `calendar_id` and `event_id` are valid and the user has write access to the calendar.

actions.title: Create Event
actions.description: Creates an event in a selected calendar using start_datetime and either end_datetime or duration fields.

actions.title: Delete event
actions.description: Deletes a specified event by `event_id` from a Google Calendar (`calendar_id`); idempotent — a 404 for an already-deleted event is a no-op.

actions.title: Create a calendar
actions.description: Creates a new, empty Google Calendar with the specified title (summary).

actions.title: List Events
actions.description: Lists or incrementally synchronizes events from one calendar, defaulting to the connected user's primary calendar.

actions.title: Move Event
actions.description: Moves an event to another calendar, i.e., changes an event's organizer.

actions.title: Find event
actions.description: Finds events in a specified Google Calendar using text query, time ranges (event start/end, last modification), and event types.

actions.title: Query Calendar Availability
actions.description: Queries raw busy intervals for one or more calendars or groups over an exact time range.

actions.title: Patch Calendar
actions.description: Partially updates (PATCHes) an existing Google Calendar, modifying only the fields provided.

actions.title: Quick Add Event
actions.description: Parses natural language text to quickly create a basic Google Calendar event with its title, date, and time, suitable for simple scheduling; does not support direct attendee addition or recurring events, and `calendar_id` must be valid if not 'primary'.

actions.title: Remove attendee from event
actions.description: Removes an attendee from a specified event in a Google Calendar; the calendar and event must exist.

actions.title: Update Google event
actions.description: Updates an existing event in Google Calendar.

actions.title: Create Google Meet Space
actions.description: Creates a new Google Meet space with optional configuration.

actions.title: Get Meet details
actions.description: Retrieve details of a Google Meet space using its unique identifier.

actions.title: Get recordings by conference record ID
actions.description: Retrieves recordings from Google Meet for a given conference record ID.

actions.title: Update Google Meet Space
actions.description: Updates the settings of an existing Google Meet space.

actions.title: Get transcripts by conference record ID
actions.description: Retrieves all transcripts for a specific Google Meet conference using its conference_record_id.

actions.title: Add Sheet to Existing Spreadsheet
actions.description: Adds a new sheet to a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Append Dimension
actions.description: Tool to append new rows or columns to a sheet, increasing its size.

actions.title: Batch update spreadsheet (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLESHEETS_VALUES_UPDATE instead.

actions.title: Clear Basic Filter
actions.description: Tool to clear the basic filter from a sheet.

actions.title: Delete Dimension (Rows/Columns)
actions.description: Tool to delete specified rows or columns from a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Delete Sheet
actions.description: Tool to delete a sheet (worksheet) from a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Get Spreadsheet by Data Filter
actions.description: Returns the spreadsheet at the given ID, filtered by the specified data filters.

actions.title: Get spreadsheet info
actions.description: Retrieves metadata for a Google Spreadsheet using its ID.

actions.title: Insert Dimension in Google Sheet
actions.description: Tool to insert new rows or columns into a sheet at a specified location.

actions.title: Set Basic Filter
actions.description: Tool to set a basic filter on a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Copy Sheet to Another Spreadsheet
actions.description: Tool to copy a single sheet from a spreadsheet to another spreadsheet.

actions.title: Append Values to Spreadsheet
actions.description: Tool to append values to a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Batch Clear Spreadsheet Values
actions.description: Tool to clear one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet.

actions.title: Batch Get Spreadsheet Values by Data Filter
actions.description: Tool to return one or more ranges of values from a spreadsheet that match the specified data filters.

actions.title: Aggregate Column Data
actions.description: Searches for rows where a specific column matches a value and performs mathematical operations on data from another column.

actions.title: Batch get spreadsheet
actions.description: Retrieves data from specified cell ranges in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Clear spreadsheet values
actions.description: Clears cell content (preserving formatting and notes) from a specified A1 notation range in a Google Spreadsheet; the range must correspond to an existing sheet and cells.

actions.title: Create a Google Sheet
actions.description: Creates a new Google Spreadsheet in Google Drive.

actions.title: Create spreadsheet column
actions.description: Creates a new column in a Google Spreadsheet.

actions.title: Create spreadsheet row
actions.description: Inserts a new, empty row into a specified sheet of a Google Spreadsheet at a given index, optionally inheriting formatting from the row above.

actions.title: Find worksheet by title (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use GetSpreadsheetInfo instead.

actions.title: Format cell
actions.description: Applies text and background cell formatting to a specified range in a Google Sheets worksheet.

actions.title: Get sheet names
actions.description: Lists all worksheet names from a specified Google Spreadsheet (which must exist), useful for discovering sheets before further operations.

actions.title: Look up spreadsheet row
actions.description: Finds the first row in a Google Spreadsheet where a cell's entire content exactly matches the query string, searching within a specified A1 notation range or the first sheet by default.

actions.title: Search Spreadsheets
actions.description: Search for Google Spreadsheets using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

actions.title: Create sheet from JSON
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLESHEETS_CREATE_GOOGLE_SHEET1 + GOOGLESHEETS_UPDATE_VALUES_BATCH (or GOOGLESHEETS_VALUES_UPDATE / GOOGLESHEETS_SPREADSHEETS_VALUES_APPEND) instead.

actions.title: Copy Google Document
actions.description: Tool to create a copy of an existing Google Document.

actions.title: Create Footer
actions.description: Tool to create a new footer in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create Footnote
actions.description: Tool to create a new footnote in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create Header
actions.description: Tool to create a new header in a Google Document, optionally with text content.

actions.title: Create Named Range
actions.description: Tool to create a new named range in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create Paragraph Bullets
actions.description: Tool to add bullets to paragraphs within a specified range in a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Content Range in Document
actions.description: Tool to delete a range of content from a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Footer
actions.description: Tool to delete a footer from a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Header
actions.description: Deletes the header from the specified section or the default header if no section is specified.

actions.title: Delete Named Range
actions.description: Tool to delete a named range from a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Paragraph Bullets
actions.description: Tool to remove bullets from paragraphs within a specified range in a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Table Column
actions.description: Tool to delete a column from a table in a Google Document.

actions.title: Delete Table Row
actions.description: Tool to delete a row from a table in a Google Document.

actions.title: Get Charts from Spreadsheet
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all charts from a specified Google Sheets spreadsheet.

actions.title: Insert Inline Image
actions.description: Tool to insert an image from a given URI at a specified location in a Google Document as an inline image.

actions.title: Insert Page Break
actions.description: Tool to insert a page break into a Google Document.

actions.title: Insert Table in Google Doc
actions.description: Tool to insert a table into a Google Document.

actions.title: Insert Table Column
actions.description: Tool to insert a new column into a table in a Google Document.

actions.title: Insert Text into Document
actions.description: Tool to insert a string of text at a specified location within a Google Document.

actions.title: Replace All Text in Document
actions.description: Tool to replace all occurrences of a specified text string with another text string throughout a Google Document.

actions.title: Replace Image in Document
actions.description: Tool to replace a specific image in a document with a new image from a URI.

actions.title: Unmerge Table Cells
actions.description: Tool to unmerge previously merged cells in a table.

actions.title: Update Document Style
actions.description: Tool to update the overall document style, such as page size, margins, and default text direction.

actions.title: Update Table Row Style
actions.description: Tool to update the style of a table row in a Google Document.

actions.title: Create a document
actions.description: Creates a new Google Docs document using the provided title as filename and inserts the initial text at the beginning if non-empty, returning the document's ID and metadata (excluding body content).

actions.title: Create Document Markdown
actions.description: Creates a new Google Docs document, optionally initializing it with a title and content provided as Markdown text.

actions.title: Get document by id
actions.description: Retrieves an existing Google Document by its ID; will error if the document is not found.

actions.title: Search Documents
actions.description: Search for Google Documents using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

actions.title: Update Document Markdown
actions.description: Replaces the entire content of an existing Google Docs document with new Markdown text; requires edit permissions for the document.

actions.title: Update existing document
actions.description: Applies programmatic edits, such as text insertion, deletion, or formatting, to a specified Google Doc using the `batchUpdate` API method.

actions.title: Download Outlook attachment
actions.description: Downloads a specific file attachment from an email message in a Microsoft Outlook mailbox; the attachment must contain 'contentBytes' (binary data) and not be a link or embedded item.

actions.title: Create Calendar Event
actions.description: Creates a new Outlook calendar event, ensuring `start_datetime` is chronologically before `end_datetime`.

actions.title: Create contact
actions.description: Creates a new contact in a Microsoft Outlook user's contacts folder.

actions.title: Create email draft
actions.description: Creates a new Outlook email draft with subject, body, recipients, and an optional attachment.

actions.title: List Outlook contacts (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use OUTLOOK_LIST_USER_CONTACTS instead.

actions.title: Get calendar event
actions.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific calendar event by its ID from a user's Outlook calendar, provided the event exists.

actions.title: List events
actions.description: Retrieves events from a user's Outlook calendar via Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: List Messages
actions.description: List or query Outlook messages from one folder (Inbox by default) or mailbox-wide with folder='allfolders'.

actions.title: Reply to Email
actions.description: Sends a reply to an Outlook email message with optional HTML formatting, attachments, CC, and BCC recipients.

actions.title: Update email message
actions.description: Updates specified properties of an existing email message; `message_id` must identify a valid message within the specified `user_id`'s mailbox.

actions.title: Send email
actions.description: Sends an email with subject, body, recipients, and optional attachments via Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: Create a draft reply
actions.description: Creates a draft reply in the specified user's Outlook mailbox to an existing message (identified by a valid `message_id`), optionally including a `comment` and CC/BCC recipients.

actions.title: Delete calendar event (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use OUTLOOK_DELETE_CALENDAR_EVENT instead.

actions.title: Get email message
actions.description: Retrieves a specific email message by its ID from the specified user's Outlook mailbox.

actions.title: Get schedule
actions.description: Retrieves free/busy schedule information for specified email addresses within a defined time window.

actions.title: Search Outlook messages
actions.description: Search Outlook messages using powerful KQL syntax.

actions.title: Update calendar event
actions.description: Updates specified fields of an existing Outlook calendar event.

actions.title: Create online meeting
actions.description: Use to schedule a new standalone Microsoft Teams online meeting, i.e., one not linked to any calendar event.

actions.title: Create Chat
actions.description: Creates a new chat; if a 'oneOnOne' chat with the specified members already exists, its details are returned, while 'group' chats are always newly created.

actions.title: Get all chats
actions.description: Lists a specified user's Microsoft Teams chats, supporting filtering and property selection.

actions.title: Get all chat messages (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead.

actions.title: Create a channel
actions.description: (DEPRECATED: use `MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_CHANNEL`) Tool to create a new standard, private, or shared channel within a Microsoft Teams team.

actions.title: Get chat message
actions.description: Tool to get a specific chat message.

actions.title: List Teams
actions.description: Retrieves Microsoft Teams accessible by the authenticated user, allowing filtering, property selection, and pagination.

actions.title: List team channels
actions.description: Retrieves channels for a specified Microsoft Teams team ID (must be valid and for an existing team), with options to include shared channels, filter results, and select properties.

actions.title: List chat messages (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead.

actions.title: List People
actions.description: Retrieves a list of people relevant to a specified user from Microsoft Graph, noting the `search` parameter is only effective if `user_id` is 'me'.

actions.title: Send Channel Message
actions.description: Posts a new top-level message to a channel in Microsoft Teams (does NOT reply to an existing message).

actions.title: Send message to Teams chat
actions.description: Sends a non-empty message (text or HTML) to a specified, existing Microsoft Teams chat; content must be valid HTML if `content_type` is 'html'.

actions.title: Reply to Teams channel message
actions.description: (DEPRECATED: use `MICROSOFT_TEAMS_POST_MESSAGE_REPLY`) Sends a reply to an existing message, identified by `message_id`, within a specific `channel_id` of a given `team_id` in Microsoft Teams.

actions.title: List OneDrive items
actions.description: Retrieves one page of files and folders as `driveItem` resources from the root of a specified user's OneDrive.

actions.title: Search Items
actions.description: Search OneDrive for files and folders by keyword.

actions.title: Get Item Metadata
actions.description: Retrieves the metadata of a DriveItem by its unique ID.

actions.title: Create folder
actions.description: Creates a new folder in the user's OneDrive with configurable conflict behavior, optionally within a specified parent_folder (by ID or full path from root) which, if not the root, must exist and be accessible.

actions.title: Upload file
actions.description: Uploads a file to a specified OneDrive folder, automatically creating the destination folder if it doesn't exist, renaming on conflict, and supporting large files via chunking.

actions.title: Update File Content
actions.description: Tool to update an existing file's content in OneDrive.

actions.title: Download a file
actions.description: Downloads a file from a user's OneDrive using its item ID, which must refer to a file and not a folder.

actions.title: Copy Item
actions.description: Tool to copy a DriveItem (file or folder) to a new location asynchronously.

actions.title: Move Item
actions.description: Tool to move a file or folder to a new parent folder in OneDrive.

actions.title: Delete Item
actions.description: Tool to delete a DriveItem (file or folder) by its unique ID from the authenticated user's OneDrive.

actions.title: List Drives
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of Drive resources available to the authenticated user, or for a specific user, group, or site.

actions.title: Create Sharing Link
actions.description: Tool to create a sharing link for a DriveItem (file or folder) by its unique ID.

actions.title: Invite User to Drive Item
actions.description: Tool to invite users or grant permissions to a specific item in a OneDrive drive.

actions.title: Read Workbook Range
actions.description: Reads a range of cells from an Excel workbook worksheet stored in OneDrive or SharePoint using Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: Update Workbook Range
actions.description: Updates a range in a workbook worksheet using Microsoft Graph API.

actions.title: Send message
actions.description: Posts a message to a Slack channel, DM, or private group.

actions.title: Update a Slack message
actions.description: Updates a Slack message by timestamp.

actions.title: Delete a message from a chat
actions.description: Deletes a message, identified by its channel ID and timestamp, from a Slack channel, private group, or direct message conversation; the authenticated user or bot must be the original poster.

actions.title: Schedule message
actions.description: Schedules a message to a Slack channel, DM, or private group for a future time (`post_at`), requiring `text`, `blocks`, or `attachments` for content; scheduling is limited to 120 days in advance.

actions.title: Add reaction to message
actions.description: Adds a specified emoji reaction to an existing message in a Slack channel, identified by its timestamp; does not remove or retrieve reactions.

actions.title: Create channel
actions.description: Initiates a public or private channel-based conversation in a Slack workspace.

actions.title: Add single content block to Notion page (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'add_multiple_page_content' for better performance.

actions.title: Create comment
actions.description: Adds a comment to a Notion page (via `parent_page_id`) OR to an existing discussion thread (via `discussion_id`); cannot create new discussion threads on specific blocks (inline comments).

actions.title: Create Notion Database
actions.description: Creates a new Notion database as a subpage under a specified parent page with a defined properties schema.

actions.title: Create Notion page
actions.description: Creates a new page in a Notion workspace under a specified parent page or database.

actions.title: Delete a block
actions.description: Archives a Notion block, page, or database using its ID, which sets its 'archived' property to true (like moving to "Trash" in the UI) and allows it to be restored later.

actions.title: Fetch comments
actions.description: Fetches unresolved comments for a specified Notion block or page ID.

actions.title: Fetch Notion Data
actions.description: Fetches Notion items (pages and/or databases) from the Notion workspace, use this to get minimal data about the items in the workspace with a query or list all items in the workspace with minimal data

actions.title: Fetch Database
actions.description: Fetches a Notion database's structural metadata (properties, title, etc.) via its `database_id`, not the data entries; `database_id` must reference an existing database.

actions.title: Fetch database row
actions.description: Retrieves a Notion database row's properties and metadata; use fetch_block_contents for page content blocks.

actions.title: Get About Me (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use GetAboutUser instead.

actions.title: Query database
actions.description: Queries a Notion database to retrieve pages (rows).

actions.title: Update Page
actions.description: Update page properties, icon, cover, or archive status.

actions.title: Update Database Row (Page)
actions.description: Updates a specific row/page within a Notion database by its page UUID (row_id).

actions.title: Update database schema
actions.description: Updates an existing Notion database's schema including title, description, and/or properties (columns).

actions.title: Append raw Notion blocks (advanced API)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use NOTION_APPEND_TEXT_BLOCKS, NOTION_APPEND_TASK_BLOCKS, NOTION_APPEND_CODE_BLOCKS, NOTION_APPEND_MEDIA_BLOCKS, NOTION_APPEND_LAYOUT_BLOCKS, or NOTION_APPEND_TABLE_BLOCKS instead.

actions.title: Archive Notion Page
actions.description: Archives (moves to trash) or unarchives (restores from trash) a specified Notion page.

actions.title: Search Notion pages and databases
actions.description: Searches Notion pages and databases by title.

actions.title: Update block
actions.description: Updates existing Notion block's text content.

actions.title: Get Current User
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about the currently authenticated Jira user.

actions.title: Search Issues Using JQL Enhanced (POST)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use JIRA_SEARCH_ISSUES instead.

actions.title: Get Issue
actions.description: Retrieves a Jira issue by ID or key with customizable fields and expansions.

actions.title: Get all projects
actions.description: Retrieves all visible projects using the modern paginated Jira API with server-side filtering and pagination support.

actions.title: Get issue types
actions.description: Retrieves all Jira issue types available to the user using the modern API v3 endpoint; results vary based on 'Administer Jira' global or 'Browse projects' project permissions.

actions.title: Get Issue Statuses
actions.description: Retrieves all issue statuses associated with workflows from Jira.

actions.title: Get Transitions
actions.description: Retrieves available workflow transitions for a Jira issue.

actions.title: Find Users (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use JIRA_FIND_USERS2 instead.

actions.title: List Boards
actions.description: Retrieves paginated Jira boards with filtering and sorting options.

actions.title: List Sprints
actions.description: Retrieves paginated sprints from a Jira board with optional state filtering.

actions.title: Create Issue
actions.description: Creates a new Jira issue (e.g., bug, task, story) in a specified project.

actions.title: Edit Issue
actions.description: Updates an existing Jira issue with field values and operations.

actions.title: Assign Issue
actions.description: Assigns a Jira issue to a user, default assignee, or unassigns; supports email/name lookup.

actions.title: Link Issues
actions.description: Links two Jira issues using a specified link type with optional comment.

actions.title: Add Attachment
actions.description: Uploads and attaches a file to a Jira issue.

actions.title: List Issue Comments
actions.description: Retrieves paginated comments from a Jira issue with optional ordering.

actions.title: Add Comment
actions.description: Adds a comment using Atlassian Document Format (ADF) for rich text to an existing Jira issue.

actions.title: Update Comment
actions.description: Updates text content or visibility of an existing Jira comment.

actions.title: Create Sprint
actions.description: Creates a new sprint on a Jira board with optional start/end dates and goal.

actions.title: Move Issues to Sprint
actions.description: Moves one or more Jira issues to a specified active sprint.

actions.title: Search Content
actions.description: Searches one page of content from the Confluence v2 API with intelligent title ranking.

actions.title: Get Spaces
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of Confluence spaces with optional filtering.

actions.title: Get Pages
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of Confluence pages.

actions.title: Get Page by ID
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a Confluence page by its ID.

actions.title: Get Blog Posts
actions.description: Tool to retrieve a list of blog posts.

actions.title: Get Labels
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all labels in a Confluence site; use for label discovery when you need to list or page through labels.

actions.title: Get Page Versions
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all versions of a specific Confluence page.

actions.title: Get Attachments
actions.description: Tool to retrieve attachments of a Confluence page.

actions.title: Search Users
actions.description: Searches for users using user-specific queries from the Confluence Query Language (CQL).

actions.title: Create Page
actions.description: Tool to create a new Confluence page in a specified space.

actions.title: Update Page
actions.description: Tool to update an existing Confluence page, replacing the entire page content.

actions.title: Delete Page
actions.description: Tool to delete a Confluence page.

actions.title: Create Space
actions.description: Tool to create a new Confluence space.

actions.title: Create Whiteboard
actions.description: Tool to create a new Confluence whiteboard.

actions.title: Remove label from Linear issue
actions.description: Removes a specified label from an existing Linear issue using their IDs; successful even if the label isn't on the issue.

actions.title: Update issue
actions.description: Updates an existing Linear issue using its `issue_id`; requires at least one other attribute for modification, and all provided entity IDs (for state, assignee, labels, etc.) must be valid UUIDs — only `issueId` accepts key format (e.g., 'ENG-123').

actions.title: Create attachment
actions.description: Creates a new attachment and associates it with a specific, existing Linear issue.

actions.title: Create a comment
actions.description: Creates a new comment on a specified Linear issue.

actions.title: Create linear issue
actions.description: Creates a new issue in a specified Linear project and team, requiring team_id and title, and allowing optional properties like description, assignee, state, priority, cycle, and due date.

actions.title: Create a label
actions.description: Creates a new label in Linear for a specified team, used to categorize and organize issues.

actions.title: Delete issue
actions.description: Archives an existing Linear issue by its ID, which is Linear's standard way of deleting issues; the operation is idempotent.

actions.title: Download issue files
actions.description: Downloads a Linear Attachment record or a private upload embedded in issue/comment Markdown; `file_name` must include the correct extension.

actions.title: Get cycles by team ID
actions.description: Retrieves all cycles for a specified Linear team ID; cycles are time-boxed work periods (like sprints).

actions.title: Get Linear issue
actions.description: Retrieves an existing Linear issue's comprehensive details, including id, identifier, title, description, timestamps, state, team, creator, attachments, comments (with user info and timestamps, use issue.comments.nodes for comment IDs), subscribers, and due date.

actions.title: Get all cycles
actions.description: Retrieves all cycles (time-boxed sprint iterations) org-wide from the Linear account; no filters applied.

actions.title: List Linear issues
actions.description: Lists non-archived Linear issues; if project_id is not specified, issues from all accessible projects are returned.

actions.title: Get labels
actions.description: Retrieves labels from Linear.

actions.title: List Linear states
actions.description: Retrieves all workflow states for a specified team in Linear, representing the stages an issue progresses through in that team's workflow.

actions.title: Get teams
actions.description: Retrieves all teams with their members and projects.

actions.title: Run Query or Mutation
actions.description: Execute any GraphQL query or mutation against Linear's API.

actions.title: Create task in asana with specific details
actions.description: Creates a new Asana task; requires 'workspace', 'parent', or 'projects' for association, and 'followers', 'projects', 'tags' are set only at creation.

actions.title: Get a task
actions.description: Retrieves full details for a specified task GID accessible by the user; use `opt_fields` to customize returned data.

actions.title: Update a task
actions.description: Updates attributes of an existing Asana task identified by its task_gid.

actions.title: Delete a task
actions.description: Delete a task.

actions.title: Retrieve tasks for project
actions.description: Retrieves tasks from a specified Asana project, allowing filtering by completion status and selection of optional fields for detailed responses.

actions.title: Search Tasks in Workspace
actions.description: Tool to search tasks across a workspace with advanced filters.

actions.title: Create subtask
actions.description: Creates a new Asana subtask under an existing parent task (`task_gid`); `due_on` and `due_at` are mutually exclusive and cannot be set simultaneously.

actions.title: Create task comment
actions.description: Adds a new text comment (story) to an existing Asana task, appearing in its activity feed.

actions.title: Get Stories for Task
actions.description: Tool to get stories (comments, status updates, etc.) for a task.

actions.title: Create Attachment for Task
actions.description: Tool to upload an attachment to a task.

actions.title: Create a project
actions.description: Creates a new Asana project in the specified workspace.

actions.title: Get a project
actions.description: Retrieves a specific Asana project by its `project_gid`, with an option to include additional fields for comprehensive details using `opt_fields`; this action does not return tasks within the project.

actions.title: Get multiple projects
actions.description: Returns a list of projects filtered by workspace or team (one required), with optional archived status filter, supporting pagination for large datasets.

actions.title: Create a section in a project
actions.description: Creates a new SECTION (not a task) in a project.

actions.title: Get current user
actions.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's full record, including accessible workspaces, often used as an initial call to establish user context for subsequent operations.

actions.title: Create folder
actions.description: Creates a new ClickUp Folder within the specified Space, which must exist and be accessible.

actions.title: Create list
actions.description: Creates a new list in ClickUp within an existing folder.

actions.title: Create a task
actions.description: Creates a new ClickUp task in a specific list, optionally as a subtask if a `parent` task ID (which cannot be a subtask itself and must be in the same list) is provided.

actions.title: Create task comment
actions.description: Adds a comment to a ClickUp task; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

actions.title: Delete task
actions.description: Permanently deletes a task, using its standard ID or a custom task ID (requires `custom_task_ids=true` and `team_id`).

actions.title: Get task
actions.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a ClickUp task by its ID, supporting standard or custom task IDs (requires `team_id` for custom IDs).

actions.title: Update task
actions.description: Updates attributes of an existing task; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true, use a single space (" ") for `description` to clear it, and provide at least one modifiable field.

actions.title: Create task attachment
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use `create_task_attachment` to upload a file to a task; requires `multipart/form-data`.

actions.title: Create checklist
actions.description: Creates a new checklist with a specified name within an existing task, which can be identified by its standard ID or a custom task ID (if `custom_task_ids` is true, `team_id` is also required).

actions.title: Create folderless list
actions.description: Creates a new folderless list (a list not part of any Folder) directly within a specified ClickUp Space.

actions.title: Create folder view
actions.description: Creates a new, highly customizable view within a specific ClickUp folder using its `folder_id`.

actions.title: Create goal
actions.description: Creates a new goal in a ClickUp Team (Workspace).

actions.title: Create list comment
actions.description: Adds a new comment with specific text to an existing and accessible ClickUp List, assigns it to a user, and sets notification preferences for all list members.

actions.title: Create space
actions.description: Creates a new ClickUp Space within a specified Workspace, allowing feature configuration which defaults to Workspace settings if unspecified.

actions.title: Delete a time entry
actions.description: Deletes an existing time entry, specified by `timer_id`, from a Workspace identified by `team_id`.

actions.title: Delete checklist
actions.description: Permanently deletes an existing checklist identified by its `checklist_id`.

actions.title: Delete checklist item
actions.description: Permanently deletes an existing item, identified by `checklist_item_id`, from an existing checklist, identified by `checklist_id`.

actions.title: Delete comment
actions.description: Deletes an existing comment from a task using its `comment_id`.

actions.title: Delete folder
actions.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a specified folder and all its contents (Lists, Tasks) if the folder_id exists.

actions.title: Delete list
actions.description: Permanently deletes an existing List and all its contents; this action is destructive and irreversible via the API.

actions.title: Delete space
actions.description: Permanently deletes a specified Space in ClickUp; this action is irreversible as the Space cannot be recovered via the API.

actions.title: Delete team
actions.description: Permanently deletes an existing Team (user group) from the Workspace using its `group_id`.

actions.title: Delete view
actions.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes an existing View in ClickUp, identified by its `view_id`.

actions.title: Get folders
actions.description: Retrieves Folders within a specified ClickUp Space, ensuring `space_id` is valid, with an option to filter by archived status.

actions.title: Get goals
actions.description: Retrieves goals for a specified ClickUp Workspace (Team); the `team_id` must be valid and accessible.

actions.title: Get lists
actions.description: Retrieves all lists within a specified, existing ClickUp folder, optionally filtering by archived status.

actions.title: Get list members
actions.description: Retrieves all members of a specific, existing ClickUp List by its ID.

actions.title: Get spaces
actions.description: Retrieves Spaces for a Team ID; member information for private Spaces is returned only if the authenticated user is a member.

actions.title: Get task members
actions.description: Retrieves users with explicit access (directly assigned or shared) to a specific existing task, excluding users with inherited permissions.

actions.title: Get user
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific user within a ClickUp Workspace (Team), available only for Workspaces on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

actions.title: Update folder
actions.description: Updates the name of an existing folder in ClickUp.

actions.title: Update list
actions.description: Updates attributes of an existing ClickUp list, such as its name, content, due date, priority, assignee, or color status, identified by its `list_id`.

actions.title: Update goal
actions.description: Updates attributes of an existing ClickUp goal, identified by its `goal_id`.

actions.title: Update space
actions.description: Updates an existing ClickUp Space, allowing modification of its name, color, privacy, and feature settings (ClickApps).

actions.title: Update team
actions.description: Updates an existing ClickUp User Group (Team) using its `group_id`; note that adding a view-only guest as a paid member may incur charges.

actions.title: Add users to board
actions.description: Adds users to a Monday.com board with a specified role.

actions.title: Change simple column value
actions.description: Changes a specific column's value for a Monday.com item using a simple string, suitable for Text, Status, or Dropdown columns; can create new labels if `create_labels_if_missing` is true for Status/Dropdown columns.

actions.title: Create a Monday board
actions.description: Creates a Monday.com board; `template_id` if used must be accessible, and `folder_id` must be in `workspace_id` if both are provided.

actions.title: Create column
actions.description: Creates a new column with a specified type and title on a monday.com board.

actions.title: Create item
actions.description: Creates a new item on a Monday.com board, optionally assigning it to a group and setting column values.

actions.title: List Monday boards (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use MONDAY_BOARDS instead.

actions.title: List board items
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use MONDAY_ITEMS_PAGE instead, which supports cursor-based pagination.

actions.title: List users
actions.description: Retrieves a list of users from Monday.com.

actions.title: Move item to group
actions.description: Moves an item to a different group on the same Monday.com board; the item and group must exist.

actions.title: Update board
actions.description: Updates a specified attribute of an existing board on Monday.com.

actions.title: Archive item
actions.description: Archives an existing Monday.com item, moving it from active board views to the archive where it can be potentially restored.

actions.title: Archive board
actions.description: Archives a specified, existing, and unarchived board in Monday.com; archived boards can typically be restored later.

actions.title: Create group
actions.description: Creates a new group with the given `group_name` on an existing Monday.com board, identified by its `board_id`.

actions.title: Delete column
actions.description: Deletes a specified column from a Monday.com board; this action is destructive and cannot be undone via the API.

actions.title: Delete group
actions.description: Permanently deletes an existing group (and its items) from an existing board in Monday.com.

actions.title: Duplicate item
actions.description: Duplicates an item on a Monday.com board, optionally including its updates.

actions.title: List groups
actions.description: Tool to retrieve all groups of a specified board.

actions.title: List columns (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use MONDAY_COLUMNS instead.

actions.title: List items
actions.description: Retrieves specified subitems from Monday.com using their IDs, returning raw JSON.

actions.title: Move item to board
actions.description: Moves a Monday.com item to a specified board and group; requires the item, target board, and target group to exist.

actions.title: List repositories for the authenticated user
actions.description: Lists repositories for the authenticated user; using 'type' with 'visibility' or 'affiliation' API parameters (not in this model) can cause a 422 error.

actions.title: Get a repository
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about an existing and accessible GitHub repository.

actions.title: Search repositories
actions.description: Searches GitHub repositories using a flexible query (keywords, qualifiers) with sorting, ordering, and pagination.

actions.title: Get a pull request
actions.description: Retrieves a specific pull request from a GitHub repository using its owner, repository name, and pull request number.

actions.title: Get a branch
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specified branch within a GitHub repository.

actions.title: Search commits
actions.description: Finds commits on GitHub using a query string (q) supporting keywords and qualifiers, with options for sorting and pagination.

actions.title: Search users
actions.description: Searches for users on GitHub by criteria like username, email, location, followers, or repository associations, using a flexible query string `q`.

actions.title: Add assignees to an issue
actions.description: Adds assignees to a GitHub issue.

actions.title: Create an issue comment
actions.description: Creates a new comment on an existing GitHub issue or pull request within the specified repository.

actions.title: Update an issue comment
actions.description: Updates an existing comment on an issue or pull request within a specified repository.

actions.title: Create a pull request
actions.description: Creates a pull request in a GitHub repository, requiring existing `base` and `head` branches; `title` or `issue` must be provided.

actions.title: Create a review for a pull request
actions.description: Creates a pull request review, allowing approval, change requests, or comments; `body` is required if `event` is `REQUEST_CHANGES` or `COMMENT`, and omitting `event` makes the review `PENDING`.

actions.title: Check if pull request merged
actions.description: Checks if a specified GitHub pull request has been merged, indicated by a 204 HTTP status (merged) or 404 (not merged/found).

actions.title: Create a repository for the authenticated user
actions.description: Creates a new repository for the authenticated user, optionally within an organization if `team_id` is specified.

actions.title: Rename a branch
actions.description: Renames an existing branch in a GitHub repository; the new name must be unique and adhere to GitHub's naming conventions, and the current branch name cannot contain wildcard characters.

actions.title: Create an issue
actions.description: Creates a new issue in a GitHub repository, requiring the repository to exist and have issues enabled; specific fields like assignees, milestone, or labels may require push access.

actions.title: Create a review comment for a pull request
actions.description: Creates a review comment on a pull request's diff, targeting a specific line, range of lines, an entire file, or replying to an existing comment.

actions.title: List contacts
actions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot contacts.

actions.title: Read contact
actions.description: Retrieves a HubSpot contact by its ID.

actions.title: Read contacts
actions.description: Batch read multiple HubSpot contacts by their IDs or custom identifier property.

actions.title: List companies
actions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot companies.

actions.title: Batch read companies by properties
actions.description: Batch-retrieves up to 100 HubSpot company records by their IDs in a single request.

actions.title: Read crm object by id
actions.description: Retrieves a specific CRM object (e.g., contact, company, deal, ticket) by its ID or a unique property, optionally including specific properties, history, and associations.

actions.title: Read a page of objects by type
actions.description: Retrieves a paginated list of objects for a specified and valid HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom ID).

actions.title: Create contacts
actions.description: Creates multiple new HubSpot contacts in a single batch operation.

actions.title: Update contact
actions.description: Updates properties for an existing HubSpot contact.

actions.title: Create companies
actions.description: Creates multiple new HubSpot companies in a single batch operation.

actions.title: Create tickets
actions.description: Creates multiple HubSpot tickets in a batch, each with its own properties and associations; `inputs` list must not be empty, each item needs `properties`, and associations/custom properties must be validly defined using internal names for custom fields and ISO 8601 for dates.

actions.title: Update ticket
actions.description: Updates properties for an existing HubSpot ticket.

actions.title: Update deal
actions.description: Updates properties for an existing HubSpot deal.

actions.title: Create deal
actions.description: Creates a new HubSpot deal.

actions.title: Update deals
actions.description: Updates multiple HubSpot deals in a single batch operation.

actions.title: Create deals
actions.description: Creates multiple deals in HubSpot CRM; ensure any associated object IDs, deal stages, and pipeline IDs specified are valid and exist within the HubSpot account.

actions.title: Create note
actions.description: Creates a new HubSpot CRM note.

actions.title: Create Contact From Natural Language
actions.description: Creates a new contact in HubSpot from a natural language description.

actions.title: Get user info
actions.description: Retrieves information about the current user or a specific user in Salesforce.

actions.title: Run SOQL query
actions.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data.

actions.title: Execute SOQL query (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY instead.

actions.title: Create account
actions.description: Creates a new account in Salesforce with the specified information.

actions.title: Update account
actions.description: Updates an existing account in Salesforce with the specified changes.

actions.title: Get account
actions.description: Retrieves a specific account by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

actions.title: Create lead
actions.description: Creates a new lead in Salesforce.

actions.title: Update lead
actions.description: Updates an existing lead in Salesforce with the specified changes.

actions.title: Delete lead
actions.description: Permanently deletes a lead from Salesforce.

actions.title: Retrieve lead by id
actions.description: Retrieves details for a Salesforce Lead by its ID; the specified Lead ID must exist in Salesforce.

actions.title: Apply lead assignment rules
actions.description: Applies configured lead assignment rules to a specific lead, automatically routing it to the appropriate owner based on your organization's rules.

actions.title: Create contact
actions.description: Creates a new contact in Salesforce with the specified information.

actions.title: Update contact
actions.description: Updates an existing contact in Salesforce with the specified changes.

actions.title: Delete contact
actions.description: Permanently deletes a contact from Salesforce.

actions.title: Query contacts by name
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Finds Salesforce Contact records by name using a case-insensitive search.

actions.title: Create opportunity
actions.description: Creates a new opportunity in Salesforce with the specified information.

actions.title: Update opportunity
actions.description: Updates an existing opportunity in Salesforce with the specified changes.

actions.title: Retrieve opportunities data
actions.description: Retrieves all available Opportunity records, representing potential revenue-generating deals, from Salesforce.

actions.title: Create note
actions.description: Creates a new note attached to a Salesforce record with the specified title and content.

actions.title: Create a meeting
actions.description: Enable Zoom meeting creation via user-level apps with "me".

actions.title: Get a meeting
actions.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Zoom meeting by its ID.

actions.title: Get a meeting summary (Paid accounts only)
actions.description: IMPORTANT: This action requires a PAID Zoom account (Pro, Business, or Enterprise plan).

actions.title: Get meeting recordings
actions.description: To download meeting recordings, use `download_url`.

actions.title: List all recordings
actions.description: This text details how to list Zoom cloud recordings for a user, notably by using "me" for user-level apps and requiring an OAuth token for access.

actions.title: List meetings
actions.description: This Zoom API lists a user's scheduled meetings using the `me` value for user-level apps, excluding instant meetings and only showing unexpired ones.

actions.title: Add a meeting registrant
actions.description: Registers a participant for a Zoom meeting that has registration enabled.

actions.title: Add a webinar registrant
actions.description: Registers a participant for a Zoom webinar that has registration enabled.

actions.title: Delete meeting recordings
actions.description: Deletes all cloud recordings for a meeting or webinar.

actions.title: Get a webinar
actions.description: Access Zoom Webinar details requires Pro or higher plan and Webinar add-on.

actions.title: Get daily usage report
actions.description: The daily report provides Zoom service usage details, like new users, meetings, participants, and minutes per day for a month, requiring a Pro plan or higher.

actions.title: Get past meeting participants
actions.description: Retrieves the list of participants who attended a past (ended) Zoom meeting.

actions.title: List archived files
actions.description: Lists archived meeting and webinar files within a specified date range (max 7 days).

actions.title: List devices
actions.description: Lists devices in your Zoom account managed through Zoom Device Management (ZDM).

actions.title: List webinars
actions.description: The API lists all scheduled webinars for Zoom users with a webinar plan, using `me` for user-level apps.

actions.title: List webinar participants
actions.description: Get a list of past webinar participants with a Pro plan or above plus an add-on.

actions.title: Update a meeting
actions.description: To update a meeting via API, ensure `start_time` is future-dated; `recurrence` is needed.

actions.title: Create file request
actions.description: Tool to create a new file request in Dropbox.

actions.title: Create folder
actions.description: Tool to create a new folder at a specified path in Dropbox.

actions.title: Create paper document
actions.description: Creates a new Dropbox Paper document at the specified path using HTML or Markdown content.

actions.title: Move file or folder
actions.description: Move file or folder

actions.title: Search File or Folder
actions.description: Tool to search for files and folders in Dropbox by name or content, optionally scoped to a path, with pagination support.

actions.title: Delete file or folder (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use DeleteFile instead.

actions.title: Get about me
actions.description: Tool to get information about the current user's Dropbox account.

actions.title: List files in folder
actions.description: Tool to list files and folders in a specified Dropbox directory.

actions.title: List folder contents (Deprecated)
actions.description: DEPRECATED: Use ListFilesInFolder instead.

actions.title: Read a file
actions.description: Downloads a file from the specified Dropbox path, requiring `files.content.read` scope.

actions.title: Upload File
actions.description: Uploads a file (up to ~150 MB) to a specified path in the user's Dropbox, with options for handling existing files.
